Controls

build — P1: WASD to move, mouse to aim, hold click to fire. On touch, left half moves and right half aims. Press 1–6 to pick a weapon (fists, spud gun, potato throw, blasters, shotgun, nuke) from the bar along the bottom (tap it on a phone), and drag a slot onto another to swap them. Press P to drop in a local player 2 (arrow keys + space, or a second gamepad) — that's the same code path the networked player will use. Shift dive-rolls (P2: Ctrl or Enter; two fingers on the move side; A or RB on a pad). R restarts. C calibrates the gun barrels.
